CustomField.description: Controls which severity levels are logged. ERROR = only errors. WARNING = warnings and errors. INFO = info, warnings, and errors. DEBUG = everything.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Valid values: ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG. Controls which severity levels are logged. ERROR = only errors. WARNING = warnings and errors. INFO = info, warnings, and errors. DEBUG = everything.
CustomField.label: Verbosity Level
